authorization_basis: The project owner explicitly authorized assuming completeness after being offered full 2019-2025 and January-July 2026 as a documented, unproven coverage hypothesis.
assumption: Treat the selected 2019-2025 occurrence snapshots as covering their full nominal calendar years and the selected 2026 snapshot as covering 2026-01-01 through 2026-07-31 inclusively. This is an operating assumption for conditional benchmarks, not official evidence of completeness.
known_gaps: not established; absence of a known gap is not proof that no gap exists
limitations: Missing records or months could create false negative segment-week labels and bias prevalence and all predictive metrics.
The impact is not limited to month-of-year features and is not asserted to be negligible.
2026 remains a partial-year evaluation and must not be annualized.
Historical accident features remain unavailable unless prior publication is separately demonstrated.
